verdict.rationale: An email provider could reasonably offer an AI-training opt-out or a no-training commitment, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI-model training, data-use opt-outs, or a no-training policy. One community comment says Fastmail is 'up front with how the data is handled', but it says nothing about AI training and does not establish the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
